title: LoansNow
description: Make money by lending money to someone else.
body:
# 💎 LoansNow: Player-to-Player Loan System

**LoansNow** introduces a dynamic and engaging loan system to your Minecraft server economy.

This plugin allows players to **offer loans** to others, specifying the principal amount and the agreed-upon interest. The receiving player can then **accept or reject** the offer. If accepted, the borrower is obligated to repay the full amount plus the agreed-upon interest, adding a strategic layer of finance and risk to your server.

**Key Features:**

* **Customizable Loans:** Players define the terms (principal + interest).
* **Accept/Reject System:** Borrowers maintain control over their debt.
